goal: Install and verify Codex CLI on factory nodes using ops/install_codex_cli.sh. Use secure existing CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN or KOLIBRI_CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE when present. Do not print, commit, or copy secrets. If auth is unavailable on a node, return a blocker artifact with install status and exact missing secret source. After install, verify codex --help and codex --version, then report node id, version, auth status, and logs.
role_goal: roll out a stable Codex CLI runtime to every server through Control Plane tasks
acceptance: Codex CLI install command is idempotent and uses a trusted package manager source configured by env
No tokens or auth.json content are written to git, logs, or result payloads
Each node reports codex version, help check, auth cache status, and blocker if auth secret is absent
Rollout can run in batches without manual SSH
